experiments.scope: Exact two-round BLAKE3 on64-byte messages with fourteen448-bit-prefix words. Choose m14=t-A and m15=-t-bh mod2^32 to force final round-zero a3=0. 32 prefixes and32 t values each. Seven-way packed evaluator, sparse-set with stale garbage, independent scalar checks of14 edge/initial lane instances per trial, and full digest rehash before returning a projected pair. Twenty-bit event within o0..o3,o5; source reports untrusted212/97 operation counts. Gapped-key extraction at offsets0,36,72,108,144 and sparse base2^176; exact same selected digest-bit event.
experiments.hypothesis: The new constrained family has projected birthday behavior near the independent model0.39327. This supports assessing Hfixed but does not establish independence, full-width recovery, or the0.003 allowance.
